They even gave me a vehicle to use while I was waiting! ” 2024 Toyota RAV4 XSE Owner · Oct 2025 Visit Motor Inn Auto Group Motor Inn Auto Group 1526 Le Clark Road, Carroll, IA 51401 Sales: Mon–Fri 8:00 AM – 5:30 PM · Sat 8:00 AM – 3:00 PM · Sun Closed Call (712) 792-5000 Get Directions Common Questions About Buying at Motor Inn Can I get financing if I have bad credit or no credit? + Yes. Our one-stop financial services center works with 20+ lenders to find an approval for every credit situation — including first-time buyers, rebuilding credit, and customers who were turned away elsewhere. Get pre-qualified before you shop and we'll match you to the right lender. Do you take trade-ins, and can I trade in a vehicle you don't sell? + Absolutely. We accept trades of any make or model, and a trade-in can lower the amount you finance and, in many cases, your Iowa sales tax. Use our online Value My Trade tool for a quick estimate, or bring it in and we'll appraise it on the spot. I don't live in Carroll — do you serve my town? + Yes. Motor Inn has been a regional dealer since 1937 and regularly works with drivers across Iowa, South Dakota, Minnesota and Nebraska. Many customers drive in from out of town for the price and the no-pressure experience; we'll get paperwork ready ahead of time so your visit is quick. What's the difference between the new Toyota and new Chevrolet lineups you carry? + We're a new-car franchise for both Toyota and Chevrolet. Toyota brings the RAV4, Camry, Tacoma, Highlander and Sienna, with strong reputations for reliability and resale. Chevrolet covers the Silverado, Equinox, Traverse and Trailblazer, plus heavier trucks and great value. Tell us how you'll use the vehicle and we'll cross-shop both brands honestly. Are your used vehicles inspected, and do they come with a warranty? + Every used vehicle is inspected by our certified service technicians before it's offered for sale, and we provide the vehicle history. Many units still carry remaining factory or certified pre-owned coverage, and we offer extended service-contract options through our finance center so you can drive with confidence. What is the buying process like — is it high-pressure? + No. Honest, no-pressure pricing is how we've stayed family owned since 1937 — most of our business comes from repeat customers and referrals. We give you a straightforward price, answer every question, and let you take the time you need. No games, no surprises at the desk.
